Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about automation and deliverability.

Does it require my LinkedIn login credentials? expand_more

No, ReachOut AI operates by crawling publicly visible search pages inside local browser windows. Your personal credentials are never required nor stored on our servers.

How does the AI personalize my outbound emails? expand_more

It scans the content of the recruiter's post, identifies their hiring pain points and technology stack, matches it with skills from your CV, and outputs a natural, custom pitch.

Is there a risk of being flagged as spam? expand_more

We send only one email at a time, spacing each dispatch with a randomized delay of 30 to 60 seconds. This mimics organic typing and sending, securing excellent domain reputation.

What is the purpose of "Test Mode"? expand_more

Test Mode runs the scraper and compiles recruiter profiles without sending any emails. This allows you to audit the scraped addresses and job postings before going live.
